name: wazir
description: Wazir is a model- and runtime-agnostic meta-harness that schedules AI agents, models, tools, and compute to execute tasks across local and distributed environments.

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const d of ['packages','apps'])for(const p of fs.readdirSync(d))for(const s of ['dist','node_modules']){const t=d+'/'+p+'/'+s;try{fs.rmSync(t,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch{}}"
